page.overview:
Who is Aurelion?

Aurelion was a High Elf Mage of Saphery, a Princess, and a relative of the Phoenix King Finubar.

An Elf of distant Ulthuan and acolyte of Teclis himself, Aurelion was young for her race, although still several hundred years old. Like most High Elves, she was dismissive of the abilities of Men, and saw them as a necessary nuisance and uncomfortable allies. Cultured and softly spoken, she spoke the language of Men in a cold, efficient manner that did little to mask her natural arrogance.

During the Great War Against Chaos, Aurelion led a defence of Ulthuan against an army led by the Dark Elf Sorceress Lilaeth. When Lilaeth's army was destroyed, Aurelion chose to spare Lilaeth rather than kill her because she believed it would cause her more pain to live with her failure.

After the Great War was over, Aurelion, alongside her cousin Prince Khalanos, travelled to the Empire and assisted the young Captain Stefan von Kessel in his efforts to purge the remnants of Chaos. Alas, Khalanos was later slain in battle by a mighty Daemon Prince of Khorne.
